scientific_question: Can a neighboring-temperature response relation, learned only from within-article contrasts, be transported across experimental articles after one to three target-article anchor measurements restore the absolute conductivity scale?

historical_context.prior_edge: CALiSol minus_30_C donor feature injected into a minus_40_C target model

data.feature_contract: the same 56 outcome-independent formulation features frozen for the original CALiSol analysis

deployment_contract.test_rows: all non-anchor target formulations in the held-out article

source_exclusions: every exact held-out target chemistry identity
split_and_leakage.preprocessing_fit: source-training rows only within each outer split

anchor_selection.first_anchor: target candidate minimizing mean squared distance to all candidates in the held-out article
anchor_selection.additional_anchors: candidate maximizing its minimum distance to already selected anchors
anchor_selection.sensitivity: 100 outcome-independent random anchor selections per budget

primary.training_data: minus_30_C source rows from non-held-out articles
primary.article_weighting: each source article has equal total fitting weight

same_contract_comparators.description: ordinary absolute minus_30_C model with its intercept recalibrated from the same target anchors
mean target-anchor outcome assigned to every non-anchor candidate

falsifiers_and_diagnostics.description: minus_30_C outcomes permuted within source article before the contrast model is fitted
the identical contrast method trained at plus_20_C
the identical contrast method trained on minus_40_C rows from other articles; diagnostic ceiling, not evidence of neighboring-condition borrowing

primary_estimand.scope: the same 11 held-out articles with at least eight eligible target formulations
primary_estimand.reason: isolates the value of changing the transferred object from absolute values to within-provenance response relations while holding donor, features, held-out articles and anchor information fixed

interpretation_policy.positive: supports a reusable, few-shot neighboring-condition borrowing contract in which within-provenance response relations transport after target-provenance anchoring
interpretation_policy.null: article offsets are not the only barrier, or the adjacent-temperature response relation is not stable enough to transport
interpretation_policy.negative: even the within-article response relation changes across provenance; abstention is required at this rung
interpretation_policy.allowed_claim: post-outcome-motivated mechanistic rescue on one literature-aggregated electrolyte programme
forbidden_claims: exact reproduction of MatEx or Bilinear Transduction
